payload.core_mechanism_summary: Two-dimensional DP array where DP[total][sub] tracks whether a subset of coins can achieve sum total while containing a sub-subset summing to sub. Iterates over coins in reverse to avoid double counting.
payload.rationale: The state is two-dimensional (target total sum and achievable sub-sum) updated bottom-up, matching dp_2d_state precisely. The solution uses nested loops typical of 2D DP tabulation.
